title: Pure Simorgh
summary: Simorgh cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Simorgh is a WIND Winged Beast Tribute Summon deck that punishes Spells and Traps. The small Simorghs each do something on Normal Summon and revive themselves from the GY while the opponent's Spell & Trap Zone is empty. Bird of Bringing searches a Simorgh, Bird of Calamity mills one, Bird of Protection bounces a Spell/Trap, and Bird of Beginning grants another Simorgh Normal Summon. Elborz, the Sacred Lands of Simorgh lowers Tributes, and Simorgh Repulsion bounces every Spell/Trap they control. Simorgh, Lord of the Storm tributes a WIND Winged Beast to shuffle away their card whenever a Spell/Trap activates. Simorgh, Bird of Perfection, the newest card, Normal Summons another Simorgh from the hand after a Winged Beast summon. Simorgh, Bird of Sovereignty is Forbidden.
